two_point_margin: for labels (0,h), lambda_min=1-exp(-h^2) and lambda_min/h^2 tends to 1
near_collision: exact repetitions quotient out, but arbitrarily close distinct labels force the smallest eigenvalue toward zero
observer_stratum: fixed rank r, bounded diameter, minimum separation Delta>0, and compact width range
compactness_claim: if the completed kernel is continuous and strictly positive definite on a compact collision-free stratum, its least Gram eigenvalue has a positive stratumwise minimum
rkhs_duality: the inverse family of finite PSD Gram restrictions canonically generates a direct-limit pre-Hilbert space of kernel sections, then its Hilbert completion
noncircularity_gate: Moore-Aronszajn reconstruction is equivalent to kernel positivity; only a source-derived feature map or contraction proves positivity rather than repackaging it
acceptance_test: Construct a source-derived global feature map for the completed arithmetic kernel, or prove stratumwise positive margins unconditionally with tail cutoffs depending explicitly on rank, diameter, separation, and width range.
